mechanism: Lopinavir (a CYP3A4 inhibitor) increases sodium valproate levels by inhibiting metabolism, while valproate may inhibit lopinavir metabolism, creating bidirectional interaction with risk of valproate toxicity.
action: Monitor valproate levels closely; consider alternative antiretroviral or antiepileptic agent; if coadministration necessary, reduce valproate dose and monitor for signs of toxicity including tremor, lethargy, and encephalopathy.
